Local copies of the outside libraries the staff app uses, so the app no
longer depends on (or trusts) a public CDN at run time. Do not edit these files.
To upgrade: download the new version from the same source, replace the file,
update this list, and test PDF import, Excel export, charts and icons.

  chart.umd.min.js           Chart.js 4.4.0        cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.0/dist/
  xlsx.full.min.js           SheetJS xlsx 0.18.5   cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/xlsx/0.18.5/
  pdfjs/pdf.min.js           pdf.js 3.11.174       cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/3.11.174/
  pdfjs/pdf.worker.min.js    pdf.js 3.11.174       (same)
  tabler/                    Tabler icons 3.46.0   cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tabler/icons-webfont@3.46.0/dist/
